تختبئي (form VIII)
# تَخْتَبِئِي (taḵtabiʔī) /tax.ta.bi.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# تُخْتَبَئِي (tuḵtabaʔī) /tux.ta.ba.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
